components.name: SH7305 CPU Core (SH-4A Integer + SH4AL-DSP Engine, NO HW FPU)
components.notes: Confirmed via CPU73050.dll: 0 FPU mnemonics, 40+ SH4AL-DSP mnemonics (PADD/PSUB/PMULS/MOVX/MOVY/LDRS/LDRE/DSR/MOD). Legacy FPU in sh_fpu.h is not SH7305 hardware.

components.notes: IC/OC 4-way tag/data arrays, write-back/write-through, ICBI/OCBI/OCBP/OCBWB invalidation, and CCR.ORA=1 OCRAM window.

components.name: Renesas R61524 Color TFT LCD Controller (384x216 RGB565, CS5A 0x14000000)
components.notes: GRAM write + 0x0202 GRAM Read verified (SHIFT+7 capture); 0x0000..0x06FF backed. Hardware scroll/gamma/CABC/VSync FMARK tracked for Phase 3.5.

components.name: Spansion S29GL256P 32 MiB NOR Flash CFI (CS0 0xA0000000..0xA1FFFFFF)
components.notes: Sector Erase 128 KB, Write-to-Buffer 64 B, Word Program, Autoselect, CFI Query, Unlock Bypass, Erase Suspend/Resume verified live.

components.name: Casio fx-CG50 50-Key Matrix (7 KI x 11 KO wired to PFC P/M/N & KIU)
components.notes: Exact 50-key matrix verified against cg50_keys_exact.h and Android 16 touch suite.

SH7305 INTC (Interrupt Controller: IPRA..IPRL, IMR0..12, IMCR0..12)
